meta.name: Munchkin Flint Sigil
meta.description: An enchanted flint seal crafted by the sommelier bureaucrats of St. Munchkin. Socketed into a tool, it exploits a literal loophole in the laws of intoxication: secondary splash damage harmlessly bounces off, preventing you from destroying the tiles you meant to leave intact. Only works up to depth 249m.
meta.author: jules:session
